bug_info.bug_desc: The hardware register read mux for TPM_HASH_START (address 0x020) incorrectly returns 0x00000000, so every byte lane is driven to 0x00. The spec requires TPM_HASH_START to return 0xFF bytes, so a read of this hardware-returned register observably returns the wrong data on MISO.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the RegHashStart case in hw_reg_mux to drive all 32 bits high, i.e. use 32'hFFFF_FFFF instead of 32'h0000_0000, so each selected byte lane returns 0xFF.
